roadmap.title: Story, Chapters 1-8
roadmap.description: Play the first half of the story and start side missions.

roadmap.title: Story, Chapters 9-17
roadmap.description: Finish the rest of the main story.

roadmap.title: Side missions, karma and rank
roadmap.description: Finish side missions and karma tasks to raise Pirate Rank.

roadmap.title: Skills and combat counters
roadmap.description: Learn skills and fill the combat counters during normal play.

roadmap.title: Travel and exploration
roadmap.description: Fly, travel, explore and reach the Sky Islands.

roadmap.title: Materials, crafting and chests
roadmap.description: Collect materials, plans, recipes and chests.

roadmap.title: Boss Rush
roadmap.description: Play the free Boss Rush challenge from the Thousand Sunny.

steps.text: Play Chapter 1 and find @npc{Chopper}.
Play through Chapter 5, "Suspicious Woman".

achievements.summary: Complete the main mission "Straw Hats United".

steps.text: Play through Chapter 6, "Straw Hats United", until the crew is together again.

achievements.summary: Complete the main mission "The Old Island".

steps.text: Play through Chapter 8, "The Old Island", which ends after you defeat @enemy{Fujitora}.
Play through Chapter 12, "To You".
Play through Chapter 13, "Radio Hijack".
Play through Chapter 15, "Protect All".

achievements.summary: Complete the main mission "Sky Prison, Ho!".

steps.text: Play through Chapter 16, "Sky Prison, Ho!".
Finish the story through the last chapter, Chapter 17.
Take any side mission from the map and finish it.
Keep finishing side missions. New ones open as the story and karma advance.

guide.context: No side mission can be missed, so you can work through them at your own pace.

steps.text: Finish side missions from every karma character as they open, across the whole game.
If you are still short near the end, do the Navy Fleet mission in Chapter 15 or 16 and any treasure-map side missions you skipped.

achievements.displayName: See You on the High Seas

steps.text: Finish karma tasks for the island's characters. Your Pirate Rank rises with each one.
Keep finishing karma tasks for the island's characters. Your Pirate Rank rises with each one.

achievements.displayName: Go All The Way to the Top!

guide.context: @npc{Sakazuki} only shows up in the Karma list during Chapter 15 or 16, so finish his tasks in those chapters.

steps.text: Open each character's Karma page and finish every task listed until all of them reach 100%.
In Chapter 15 or 16, find the two citizens at the Navy Fleet spot and talk to them to start the Navy Fleet side mission. It counts toward @npc{Sakazuki}'s karma.

For the boss karma tasks, fight @enemy{Kizaru}, @enemy{Kuzan}, @enemy{Fujitora}, @enemy{Crocodile} and @enemy{Smoker} as often as needed. They appear at random, so fast travel away and back to make them appear again.
Fight @enemy{Sakazuki} as often as needed during Chapter 16. He has a fixed spot.
Open the Karma page and finish every task for one side, either Pro-Navy or Anti-Navy.
Earn experience from fights and missions, then buy skills in the skill menu.

achievements.displayName: This is What I've Been Training For!

steps.text: Keep earning experience and buying skills in the skill menu.
Buy every skill in the skill menu.
If you run out of experience after the ending, play through the story again. The experience you earn is kept, and it is enough to finish the list.
Sneak up behind an enemy that has not seen you and attack to perform a Takedown.
Keep sneaking up behind enemies and using Takedowns.
Buy the @item{Consecutive Takedown} skill so one Takedown can defeat several enemies.
Aim at an enemy's head with a ranged attack.
Keep aiming at enemies' heads with ranged attacks.
Buy the ranged-attack gauge and recovery skills to fire more often.
Buy the @item{Perfect Dodge} skill, then dodge at the moment an attack is about to hit you.
Buy the @item{Perfect Guard} skill, then block at the moment an attack is about to hit you.

achievements.description: Travel a total distance of 50,000 across the island
achievements.summary: Cover 50,000 in total distance while moving around the island.

steps.text: Explore and use the world normally. The distance adds up as you play.

achievements.description: Fly with Gum-Gum Rocket for 30 minutes in total
achievements.summary: Fly for 30 minutes in total with Gum-Gum Rocket.

steps.text: Use the Gum-Gum Rocket to get around instead of walking. The time adds up as you play.

achievements.description: Fly for 5 seconds during a single Gum-Gum Rocket flight without landing
achievements.summary: Fly for 5 seconds in one Gum-Gum Rocket flight without landing.

steps.text: Launch a Gum-Gum Rocket flight from a high place and stay in the air for 5 seconds.
If it is hard, buy the Gum-Gum Rocket flight increase skill.
Smash boxes and other breakable objects as you explore.
Defeat pirate enemies as you play. Marines do not count.
Defeat Navy enemies, which the game calls Sailors, as you play. Pirates do not count.
Defeat enemies as you play. Any enemy counts.

achievements.summary: Defeat 6 enemies at the same time.

steps.text: Jump into a Navy base and use Gum-Gum Elephant Gatling Gun, which hits a wide spread, to defeat six enemies together.
Pick up the glowing sparkles on the ground and the materials from chests.
Talk to @npc{Franky} or @npc{Usopp} on the Thousand Sunny and craft equipment and outfits.

guide.context: There are more plans than the 25 needed. Plans also come from chests and the outfit chests listed under Treasure Hunter.

achievements.description: Ask Straw Hat Pirates to go exploring 3 times
achievements.summary: Send the Straw Hats exploring 3 times.

steps.text: After Chapter 7, talk to @npc{Sanji} on the Thousand Sunny.
Pick a crewmate and a lunch pack, then send them out. Repeat three times.

achievements.description: Ask Straw Hat Pirates to go exploring 12 times
achievements.summary: Send the Straw Hats exploring 12 times.

guide.context: A better lunch pack brings back more materials or better quality ones.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Sanji}, pick a crewmate and a lunch pack, then send them out. Repeat this 12 times in total.
The trip runs in real time. To skip the wait, move your computer's clock forward.
Open treasure chests as you explore. The full list is under Treasure Hunter.

guide.context: Treasure chests appear in many areas. More appear after Chapter 8 and Chapter 12, so come back to earlier areas later. Buried treasures from treasure maps are dug up and are listed at the end.

guide.context: Fast travel only works at places you have already visited.

steps.text: Visit every part of the island until every fast travel point is discovered.

achievements.displayName: I Wanna Go to the Sky Islands
achievements.description: Reach a Sky Island for the first time
achievements.summary: Arrive on any Sky Island for the first time.

steps.text: Raise @npc{Law}'s karma until he offers the side mission Mystery of the Sky Islands.
Finish that mission. The story takes you to the Sky Islands.

achievements.description: Complete Main Mission "The Void Mirror Prototype"
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission "The Void Mirror Prototype".

steps.text: Play the Void Mirror Prototype episode through to the end of its main mission.
Buy every skill on Zoro's list.
If you need more experience, replay Chapters 6 to 8 of the episode. Each run gives about 1,300 experience.
Target an enemy's head, then trigger a special move with LB.

achievements.summary: Use Serious Mode 10 times as Zoro.

steps.text: Press D-pad Up to enter Serious Mode. It uses up all of your tension.
Do Button of Admiration in Ruby Village.
Do Shodown in the Secret Factory.
Do All In in the Secret Factory.

achievements.description: Complete a Challenge Mission with the highest grade with Zoro
achievements.summary: Earn the top grade as Zoro on all three Challenge Missions.

guide.context: The in-game text says one mission is enough. You need the top grade on all three.

steps.text: Button of Admiration in Ruby Village: collect 60 buttons for five stars.
Shodown in the Secret Factory: finish in under 1 minute for five stars.
All In in the Secret Factory: finish in under 1 minute for five stars.

achievements.description: Complete all Main Missions in "Where Justice Lies"
achievements.summary: Complete every main mission in "Where Justice Lies".

steps.text: Play the Where Justice Lies episode through its last main mission.
Buy every skill on Sabo's list.
If you need more experience, replay Chapter 5 of the episode until all skills are bought.

achievements.summary: Defeat 20 enemies with a Takedown as Sabo.

steps.text: Get behind enemies and press Square.

achievements.summary: Perform 30 Flame-Flame Perfect Dodges as Sabo.

steps.text: Buy the Flame-Flame Perfect Dodge skill for 25 skill points.
Dodge with Circle at the moment an attack is about to hit you.
Finish Thrillseeker, Battle Test, Pick Master and Mirror World. The steps for each are under Top of the World.

achievements.description:
Get the top Grade as Sabo on
4 Challenge Missions
achievements.summary: Get the best grade with Sabo on four different Challenge Missions.

steps.text: Thrillseeker: start in Sapphire Town and find @npc{Mari} in the Amber Harbor Mineshaft. Finish in under 90 seconds.
Battle Test: start in the southwest corner of Steel City and find the @enemy{Pacifista} in the Steel City Mineshaft. Defeat 80 enemies.
Pick Master: start south of Amber Harbor and find @npc{Picke} north of Prison Tower Tourmaline. Finish in under 1 minute to be safe.
Mirror World: start north of Crystal Cavern and find @npc{Iris}, also north of Crystal Cavern. Finish in under 1 minute.

achievements.description: Complete all Main Missions in "The Unfinished Map"
achievements.summary: Complete every main mission in "The Unfinished Map".

steps.text: Play The Unfinished Map episode through its last main mission.
Buy every skill on Law's list.
After you clear the episode, load the cleared-game save and replay it until all skills are bought.

achievements.summary: Defeat 20 enemies with a Takedown as Law.

steps.text: Get behind enemies and press Square.

achievements.description: Use Shambles on an Enemy 30 times

steps.text: Hold RB to teleport into an enemy, then attack it.
Finish Engraving and Lost on the Floating Island. The steps for each are under The Throne.

achievements.description: Get the top Grade as Law on 2 Challenge Missions
achievements.summary: Get the best grade with Law on two different Challenge Missions.

steps.text: Engraving: start in Amber Harbor and find @enemy{Honcho} on the Floating Island. Finish in about 50 seconds for five stars.
Lost on the Floating Island: start in the west part of the Floating Island. Finish in under 60 seconds.

achievements.summary: Complete the Boss Rush challenge mission.

guide.context: Use the robot before you start the main mission of Chapter 14. After that, it is unavailable until you finish the game. This one is part of a free update, not paid DLC.

steps.text: Talk to the robot at the back of the Thousand Sunny, behind @npc{Nami}'s tangerine trees, to start Boss Rush.
Finish the run with any rank.

achievements.description: Complete "Boss Rush" with the top Grade
achievements.summary: Finish Boss Rush with the best grade.

guide.context: Weaken @enemy{Tashigi} and @enemy{Smoker} to about one quarter health, then finish them with Red Hawk. Use Elephant Gatling on @enemy{Germa 66}. Save Gear 4 for @enemy{Crocodile}, @enemy{Sakazuki} and @enemy{Isaac}.

steps.text: Start Boss Rush from the robot on the Thousand Sunny.

Beat the bosses as they come, inside the 5-minute limit. First come @enemy{Tashigi} and @enemy{Smoker}, then @enemy{Germa 66}, then @enemy{Crocodile} and @enemy{Rob Lucci}. After them come the admirals @enemy{Fujitora}, @enemy{Kuzan}, @enemy{Kizaru} and @enemy{Sakazuki}. @enemy{Isaac} is last.
Defeat @enemy{Isaac} before the time runs out. Beating him within the limit earns the top grade.
